title: Ekterly NICE Recommendation: Oral HAE Pill Backed for NHS
summary:
The Ekterly NICE recommendation issued as final draft guidance on 25 November 2026 means sebetralstat, the first oral on-demand treatment for hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks, is set for routine NHS use in England and Wales for people aged 12 and over. The decision reverses NICE’s provisional refusal in October 2025 and gives Chiesi, which agreed in April 2026 to buy developer KalVista Pharmaceuticals for about US$1.9 billion, its first major European reimbursement win for the drug.

title: FDA okays AbbVie’s RINVOQ as first systemic treatment for Vitiligo in adults & kids above 12
summary:
The US FDA has approved AbbVie’s RINVOQ (upadacitinib) as the first systemic treatment for nonsegmental vitiligo (NSV), opening a new chapter in the treatment of the chronic autoimmune disease that causes loss of skin pigmentation.

The approval covers adults and children aged 12 years and older, making RINVOQ the first and only FDA-approved targeted systemic therapy for nonsegmental vitiligo in the United States.
